# Banquet [color=#999999][italic]...is a collection of the station’s hungriest fellows along with those curating the “menu”[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color]
Key Identities: [color=darkorange]Cannibal[/color]
## Summary
Banquet is a masquerade built around the Cannibal, who can eat dead bodies to take that person's identity and objectives, leaving behind a husk. They can take on any identity, crew or otherwise, and can get a cache too!
Will the Cannibals kill to get their objectives? Or will they let the Traitors or rest of Crew do it for them?
As crew, you might want to consider hiding or disposing of Traitor's bodies so a Cannibal can't switch sides, but maybe as a Traitor you try to do the opposite to make it more likely to have a new ally if things go south.
